accounts_copy: Active user accounts are shown by default. System accounts stay hidden in normal account management.
accounts_currency_dialog_copy: This currency will be added only when the account is saved.
accounts_delete_confirm: Delete {name}? This only works for accounts with no postings or references.
accounts_empty_copy: System accounts are hidden here. Add a user account to start shaping the account list.
accounts_error_copy: Refresh the account list and try again.
accounts_no_results_copy: Adjust the filters or search term to show more accounts.
accounts_shell_copy: Review user accounts by institution, country, type, and status before transaction entry lands.
accounts_structure_locked_hint: This account has transactions, so account type, parent, institution, currency, posting behavior, and opened date are locked. Create a new account for a different structure.
accounts_tree_unassigned_hint: Assign an institution when editing an account.
api_error_conflict: This action conflicts with the current state. Refresh and try again.
api_error_config_required: The server is not configured for this action.
api_error_csrf_invalid: Your session could not be verified. Refresh and try again.
api_error_export_scope_unsupported: This export always contains the whole ledger. To export part of it, use the archive export, which records what it contains.
api_error_forbidden: You do not have access to do that.
api_error_internal_error: Something went wrong on the server. Try again.
api_error_ledger_overflow: This balance is too large to represent safely. Reduce the posting scale or split the account.
api_error_network: The server could not be reached. Check the connection and try again.
api_error_not_found: The requested item could not be found.
api_error_provider_error: The external provider rejected the request. Check the connection and try again.
api_error_qif_account_unsupported: QIF cannot represent some of the selected accounts. Export them in the archive format, or confirm to continue without them.
api_error_rate_limited: Too many attempts were made. Wait a moment and try again.
api_error_resource_busy: That resource is busy right now. Try again in a moment.
api_error_setup_already_complete: Setup is already complete. Sign in with the owner account instead.
api_error_validation_failed: Please check the highlighted values and try again.
app_shell_card_auth_copy: Cookie session, CSRF bootstrap, login throttling, and logout are now wired through a real browser flow.
app_shell_card_routing_copy: The app now has a dedicated authenticated route boundary ready for real domain screens.
app_shell_card_setup_copy: Fresh installs still land in guided setup while returning owners move into the authenticated shell.
app_shell_error_copy: Refresh the shell state and try again.
app_shell_error_title: The app shell could not load
app_shell_header_copy: This first shell route proves that setup, session introspection, logout, and app-level navigation now work together.
app_shell_loading_copy: Verifying the owner session and setup state.
app_shell_next_books_copy: Continue the accounting skeleton with institutions and account tree setup.
app_shell_next_imports_copy: Keep CSV import, duplicate review, and cleanup workflows behind the same authenticated navigation structure.
app_shell_next_reports_copy: Use the same shell frame for early trust-building views such as net worth and cashflow.
app_shell_next_transactions_copy: Introduce balanced transaction entry and the first real data-entry flow inside this shell.
app_shell_overview_copy: The authenticated shell is intentionally small: it establishes the route frame, navigation, and session-backed shell behavior before real finance domains land.
categories_delete_confirm: Delete {name}? This only works for custom categories with no children, postings, or other references.
categories_empty_copy: Add the first category before using categories in transaction entry.
categories_error_copy: Refresh the category list and try again.
categories_no_results_copy: Adjust the filters or search term to show more categories.
categories_setup_loading_copy: Preparing required categories and starter suggestions.
categories_shell_copy: Manage income and expense categories used by transaction entry and reporting.
category_tx_empty_copy: No transactions match the current filters for this category.
category_tx_error_copy: An error occurred while loading transactions for this category.
currencies_add_dialog_copy: Search the catalog and select a currency to activate it for this book.
currencies_copy: Active currencies are the currencies currently available to account and ledger workflows.
currencies_derived_warning: Derived rate; source legs may have different update times.
currencies_empty_copy: Use the Add currency button to activate a currency for this book.
currencies_error_copy: Refresh the currency settings and try again.
currencies_failed_work_copy: These exchange-rate jobs stopped retrying after repeated failures. Fix the cause, then re-enqueue them.
currencies_loading_copy: Reading active currencies, default preference, and latest observed rates.
currencies_policy_hops_hint: Intermediate currencies a derived rate may route through when no direct rate exists. 0 turns derived rates off.
currencies_refresh_finished: Refresh finished with status {status}; {count} rates checked.
home_hero_foundation_copy: UI foundations now run through semantic theme tokens so the first real screens can share one visual language across light and dark modes.
install_gate_authenticated_copy: The setup and auth foundation is working. The next product slices can build on this authenticated shell.
install_gate_currencies_copy: Pick the default currency for new accounts. Other currencies become active when you create accounts that use them.
install_gate_currencies_empty: The embedded currency catalog is unavailable.
install_gate_error_copy: Refresh the state and try again.
install_gate_error_title: The install gate could not load
install_gate_fresh_copy: Start the install by creating the single owner account. You will be signed in immediately after setup completes.
install_gate_loading_copy: Reading setup progress and the current browser session.
install_gate_login_copy: Owner setup is complete. Sign in to unlock the app shell and continue with later slices.
install_gate_non_blocking_note: Future setup domains stay visible here but do not block the app until their slices exist.
install_gate_setup_token_hint: Required for production deployments. Enter the value supplied by the server operator; it is used only for this request.
install_gate_preparing_copy: Setting up the private workspace for your financial records.
install_gate_preparing_error_copy: Workspace setup could not finish. Refresh or retry before continuing.
install_gate_recovery_backup_note: Recovery creates a verified backup first unless you explicitly use the emergency override.
install_gate_recovery_copy: The owner account and durable setup step disagree. Use the local maintenance recovery flow before continuing.
institutions_delete_confirm: Delete {name}? This only works when no accounts reference it.
register_empty_copy: There are no postings in this register for the current filters.
register_error_copy: An error occurred while fetching the account register.
settings_card_appearance_copy: Theme, base color, accent color, and visual preview.
settings_card_currencies_copy: Active currencies, precision, default preference, and latest observed rates.
settings_overview_copy: Keep broad operational status here and move focused preferences into settings sections.
settings_shell_copy: Review workspace health and manage preferences that apply across the local finance app.
transactions_correction_banner: This is a correcting transaction linked to the original. Both transactions will appear in the ledger and net to the corrected state.
transactions_detail_no_results: No transactions match the current filters.
transactions_empty_copy: No transactions match your filters. Try adjusting the filters or add a new transaction.
transactions_error_copy: An error occurred while loading transactions.
transactions_payee_confirm_suggestions: Did you mean one of these?
transactions_from_report: Showing the transactions behind one report row.
transactions_reconciliation_warning_copy: The following reconciliation checkpoints will be invalidated. You will need to re-reconcile the affected accounts after saving.
transactions_reconciliation_warning_titl: This change affects a reconciled period
transactions_restore_reason_placeholder: Why is this transaction being restored?
transactions_soft_delete_copy: The transaction will be hidden from the ledger but can be recovered from Settings → Trash.
transactions_soft_delete_reason_placehol: Why is this transaction being deleted?
transactions_unvoid_reason_placeholder: Why is this transaction being unvoided?
transactions_void_reason_placeholder: Why is this transaction being voided?
transactions_voided_edit_blocked: This transaction is voided. Unvoid it first to make changes.
investments_shell_copy: View open positions and lot-level detail across your brokerage accounts.
investments_empty_copy: Record a buy to see your portfolio here.
investments_form_invalid_number: Please enter valid numbers for quantity and amount.
investments_form_amount_too_large: Amount is too large to represent exactly. Please enter a smaller value.
investments_gains_realized_empty: No realized gains in this period.
trash_description: Soft-deleted transactions. Restore to bring them back into the ledger.
trash_empty_description: Soft-deleted transactions appear here. You can restore them at any time.
trash_restore_confirm_description: Restoring this transaction would re-enter postings into a reconciled period. The following checkpoints will be invalidated:
install_gate_mfa_hint: Enter the current code from your authenticator app, or one of your recovery codes.
security_mfa_description: Require a code from an authenticator app in addition to your password. Recommended before exposing this app to the internet.
security_mfa_enroll_step_hint: Scan or paste the key below, then enter the code it shows to finish. Nothing changes until you do.
security_mfa_enroll_step_title: Add this to your authenticator app
security_mfa_password_hint: Your password is required again so a stolen session cannot change how your account is protected.
security_mfa_pending_hint: A previous setup was started but never confirmed. Starting again replaces it.
security_mfa_recovery_warning: Save these somewhere safe. Each works once, they are shown only now, and they are the only way in if you lose your authenticator.
security_mfa_unconfigured: Two-factor authentication needs REKENRAAM_SECRET_KEY set on the server, so the shared secret can be encrypted at rest. Set it and restart to enable this.
investments_form_negative_number: Enter a positive value. Quantities and amounts cannot be negative; use the matching sell, write-off, or correction instead.
settings_data_subtitle: Export your ledger, check your backups, and verify the books.
settings_data_export_copy: Take your ledger with you. Exports are plain files: nothing here needs this app to read it.
settings_data_export_format_bundle_hint: The ledger, the tables it refers to, a trial balance that checks it, and a manifest of what is inside.
settings_data_export_format_csv_hint: One flat file of every posting. Always the whole ledger — a scoped export needs the archive's manifest to be reproducible.
settings_data_export_format_qif_hint: One file per cash account, for older finance apps. Investment accounts cannot be written as QIF.
settings_data_export_date_layout_hint: QIF does not record which layout it uses, so it is stated in the filename.
settings_data_backups_copy: The app backs itself up while it runs. Each copy is verified before it is kept.
settings_data_backups_queued: Queued. It will appear below when it finishes.
settings_data_backups_key_title: Your encryption key is not in the backup
settings_data_selfcheck_copy: Checks the books against themselves. It only ever reports — it never changes anything.
